items.question: How many e-bike rides can a UAE monthly membership user take within a 30-day period before exceeding the fair-usage limit?
items.gold: No more than 90 e-bike rides within a 30-day period.
items.fact: UAE monthly membership fair-usage cap is 90 rides per 30 days

items.question: What is the extra time charge in AED for every 30 minutes beyond the free 45 minutes on a Single Trip pass?
items.fact: Extra time costs AED 10 per 30 minutes after free 45 minutes
